newsitem.title: USA: Coachmen abandons talks to buy New England Homes.
newsitem.headline: Coachmen abandons talks to buy New England Homes.

text.p: Coachmen Industries Inc said Thursday that discussions to buy New England Homes were being abandoned because a definitive agreement between the companies could not be reached.

Earlier this month, Coachmen, a recreational vehicle and modular home maker, had said it reached an agrement in principle to by New England HOmes, a Greenland, New Hampshire-based modular home builder.
Coachmen officials were not available to further elaborate.
Coachmen shares were down 3/8 at 18-3/4 Thursday.
